title: Japan's leader says Trump called her as dispute with China doesn't go away
description: Only weeks into the job, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi infuriated China by suggesting Japan could respond militarily if China were to try to seize control of Taiwan, the self-governing island that Beijing says must come under its rule.

title: Diplomatic Strain: Japan Responds to Chinese Allegations on Taiwan
description: Japan rejects a Chinese accusation at the U.N. that Tokyo threatens armed intervention over Taiwan. This tension arises from a statement by Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, suggesting Japan might respond to a Chinese attack on Taiwan, leading to strained diplomatic relations and canceled cultural events in China.

title: Taiwan Counters China's Historical Claims Amid US-China Talks
description: Taiwan has accused China of distorting WWII documents to support its claims over the island. This accusation follows a call between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump. Taiwan asserts its sovereignty, while emphasizing US-Taiwan communication, and accuses China of using intimidation tactics against neighbors.

title: China twists WWII history to justify expansionism and intimidate Taiwan, MOFA warns
description: The statement came a day after a phone conversation between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump, during which Xi allegedly linked Taiwan's 'return to China' to the postwar international order, as reported by The Taipei Times.
